name: Reclaimers' Business in Desolace
summary: Roetten Stonehammer sends travelers from Ironforge across the sea to Desolace for paid work with the Reclaimers. At Nijel's Point, Kreldig Ungor needs help recovering lost treasures and relics.

sections.title: A Call to the Wasteland
sections.body: Beyond the sea, Desolace is a harsh stretch of Kalimdor ruled by warring centaur clans. The Reclaimers seek profit among its forgotten ruins and barren lands. For those willing to face the danger, the journey may pay well.

sections.title: Nijel's Point and the Reclaimers
sections.body: The route runs west through the Stonetalon Mountains and into northern Desolace. High among the cliffs, Nijel's Point is an Alliance outpost where Kreldig Ungor welcomes new hands. The Reclaimers recover heirlooms, magical artifacts, and family treasures lost across the war-torn world. For the right price, Kreldig and his associates retrieve those valuables from the wild.

faq.answer: Roetten Stonehammer offers paid work in Ironforge and sends you across the sea to meet his associate in Kalimdor.

aliases: how to get to nijels point
faq.answer: Nijel's Point lies in Desolace's northeastern crags. From the Stonetalon Mountains, travel south into Desolace, then follow the cliffs east to the torchlit path climbing to the Alliance outpost.
The Reclaimers are a venture led by dwarven operatives such as Kreldig Ungor. For paying clients, they recover lost heirlooms, antiquities, and magical relics from dangerous places.
Warring centaur tribes, undead remnants, and hostile wildlife threaten travelers in Desolace, an arid wasteland beyond the Stonetalon Mountains.
Kreldig Ungor is a dwarf at Nijel's Point in Desolace. He organizes salvage work and relic hunts across the region, recruiting capable travelers to face its ruins and centaur camps.

faq.q: Is this quest required to quest in Desolace?
faq.answer: No. You can travel to Nijel's Point without Roetten Stonehammer, though he offers background and directions before you set out.

angles.text: Nijel's Point is the main Alliance sanctuary in the western wastes of central Kalimdor. Hostile centaur clans surround it.
As a dwarf, you can find dwarven enterprise even in Kalimdor's bleakest corners, from the Explorers' Guild to independent salvage groups like the Reclaimers.
